scenarios.title: Safeguard Verification: Isobutane Pump Reinstated (Zero Energy Verification)
scenarios.description: Learner acts as the outside operator and permit approver-verifier for P-101 isobutane pump recommissioning. Navigate safeguard verification, physical walkdown, zero energy confirmation, and start work approval using correct communication protocols.
scenarios.subject: P-101 Isobutane Pump

outcomes.title: Safe Proceed — Zero Energy Verified
outcomes.description: You prevented an incident by requiring proof of zero energy — not just a gauge reading. Work proceeded after bleeder/vent verification and aligned start work expectations. Debrief: You demonstrated verification discipline, critical safeguard focus, and closed-loop communication. How will you apply this verification approach on the next job?

outcomes.title: Incident: Flange Break
outcomes.description: Work proceeded to flange break. Residual pressure/gas released; local monitors alarmed; workers evacuated. One crew member was transported offsite. The critical miss: approving start work without proving zero energy — the bleeder/vent was never opened. Debrief: What verification dialogue should have happened before sign-off? What will you do differently next time?

outcomes.title: Incident: Valve Blowby
outcomes.description: Work proceeded to valve blowby. Residual pressure/gas released during recommissioning; evacuation initiated. The critical miss: approving start work without proving zero energy — the bleeder/vent verification step was skipped. Debrief: What verification step was missed? What stop-work triggers should have applied?

scenes.title: SWC Walkthrough Dialogue
scenes.description: Tom verbally walks through all hard isolations: breaker VE03A off with LOTO lock/tag; inlet, discharge, outlet, vent, bypass, and return valves all closed and locked/tagged. Learner must request zero energy verification — specifically that the bleeder valve be opened to prove zero pressure — before signing off.
